_comment: Channel profile for the Merge_videos composer.
Read by Merge_videos/manifest.py when a compose.json says "channel": <this folder>.
It is a DEFAULTS LAYER: any key here is overridden by the same key in a manifest, which is
in turn overridden per segment. Set here what is true of every Aeonium Glow video; set in
the manifest what is true of one video.
The composer does not import anything from longform_pipeline and has no Aeonium-specific
code. It reads a directory a manifest names and expects this file in it. That is the entire
coupling, and it runs in one direction only -- nothing in this pipeline depends on the
Paths resolve relative to THIS FILE's folder, so bgm.mp3 is the copy sitting beside it and
stays correct no matter where the composition project lives.
VOICE IS THE HOST, NOT A NARRATOR. Cards are spoken by a single recurring presenter who
opens, bridges and closes; the source videos carry their own voices. Changing this value
recasts the host across every future composition, so it belongs here rather than being
restated per project where it would drift.
BGM levels are TARGETS IN LUFS, not multipliers -- the track is measured once and gained to
hit them, so swapping bgm.mp3 for a louder or quieter piece needs no other edit.
name: Aeonium Glow
